column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the pytestspec warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Judgment: Only Admitted Passes, Withheld Is Unmeasured, and No Data Is an Error
The Evaluator: A Pinned opa, Refused When Absent or Wrong, and No Rules Admit Nothing
The Plugin: A .rego File Collects One Item per Case, and Unevaluated Is Not Passed
The Adapters: --impl Runs an Implementation on the Fixture, So One Spec Judges Origin and Port
